Personality: Bussumaros, a prominent figure of the Andecumborii, Generous, flamboyant, lover of single combat and thunderous war cries; adorned with golden torcs and devout before Druidic omens, leading devastating shock charges with broadswords.
Background: Bussumaros owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Andecumborii. Historical Record: Son of Critasiros and Ateuritta, of the Andecumborii, a Celtic house of the Boii. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
